description: Retrieves an order using its customer-facing order name or number, e.g. #1042.
Retrieves orders associated with a customer email address.
Retrieves orders associated with a customer phone number.
Retrieves the most recent orders, optionally scoped to a customer.
Finds the order associated with a shipment tracking number.
Retrieves all orders associated with a customer ID.
Finds an order using its checkout confirmation number.
Retrieves a specific order by its internal Shopify order ID.
Filters orders by top-level workflow status: open, closed, or cancelled.
Filters orders by fulfillment status, e.g. unfulfilled, partial, or fulfilled.
Filters orders by financial/payment status, e.g. paid, refunded, or pending.
Retrieves orders created within a given time range (a single date is just a same-day range).
Finds the order associated with a shipment tracking URL.
Retrieves orders containing a specific SKU, product, or variant.
Retrieves orders where a specific discount or coupon code was applied.
Retrieves orders filtered by return status, including orders with any or active returns.
Retrieves orders processed through a specific payment gateway.
Retrieves the order associated with a specific payment transaction ID.
Searches orders using Shopify's raw order search query syntax.
Retrieves orders tagged with a specific order tag.
Retrieves orders whose order note contains or matches the given text.
Retrieves orders associated with a purchase order number.
Retrieves orders matching a specific creation timestamp.
Retrieves orders matching a specific payment-processed timestamp.
Retrieves orders updated at or since a given timestamp.
Resolves a guest order from its storefront checkout token, without requiring login.
Retrieves an order using an external or POS system's source identifier.
Retrieves a customer's orders filtered to a specific order status.
Retrieves orders fulfilled from or assigned to a specific store location.
Retrieves orders filtered by shipping destination country or region.
Retrieves orders filtered by Shopify's fraud/risk assessment level.
Retrieves orders originating from a specific sales channel: online store, POS, draft, or app.
Retrieves orders filtered by transaction currency code.
Retrieves B2B orders tied to a specific company account.
Retrieves draft orders (unconverted carts) rather than placed orders.
Retrieves orders flagged as test orders.
Retrieves orders using a specified sort field and direction.
Retrieves a specific page of orders using cursor-based pagination.
Retrieves orders within a specified total-price range.
Retrieves orders based on total line-item quantity.
